summary.text: Lee Snodgrass is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 52 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her current term as beginning on January 6, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Lee Snodgrass was born in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, lives in Appleton, Wisconsin, and earned a B.A. in English from the University of Wisconsin at Madison, according to Ballotpedia.
Her career experience includes working as the director of communications for Girl Scouts of the Northwestern Great Lakes.
